$comment: draft-07. task-dod/verified/<task_key>-<verified_sha>.json — EVIDENCE that a collected task-dod/<task_key>.json contract was checked. Separate file, separate lifecycle from the contract (task-dod.schema.json), which stays append-only and is never mutated by verification. requirement_index is the 0-based index into the collected contract's requirements[] array — a stable reference back to the immutable contract without duplicating requirement text. Uses only the keyword subset hc_validate supports (type/required/properties/items/enum/const/additionalProperties/oneOf/not/minLength) — no pattern/minItems/format.
